visualCharacteristics.purpose: Advisor search results page: title, filter and sort controls, result count, list of advisors (photo, rating, name, address, distance, homepage link, badge) beside a map panel
visualCharacteristics.layout: Results list left, map panel right on desktop; stacked on mobile; no-map renders the list full width

contentPattern.structure: 1 cell heading = title; label | list = filter or sort select (bold item selected); 1 cell text = result summary; picture | details | optional badge = one advisor (details: rating, name, address, distance, links); 'Map' (or 'Karte') | content = map panel (consent notice and button); rows after the last advisor also go to the map panel

reuseGuidance: Use advisor-finder for every advisor / agency search result page; use the no-map option for list-only instances. The block renders the authored advisors, filter and sort options and the map consent notice statically: live advisor search, geolocation, filtering/sorting, the Google Maps embed and any submission are out of scope for now and need a later integration pass.
